newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia to launch new NMT 900 RinGo phone.
newsitem.headline: Nokia to launch new NMT 900 RinGo phone.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it would launch a new RinGo consumer handset for analogue NMT 900 networks in Finland, Sweden, the Netherlands and Thailand in March.
"We expect the new Nokia RinGo to be a stellar performer in the NMT 900 market," it said.
The model is already available in Denmark, Nokia said.

The new RinGo comes with an integrated battery offering "carefree and reliable power management," Nokia said, adding the handset had a talk time of up to four hours and standby time of up to five days.
It said the new Nokia RinGo was smaller, lighter and more compact than its previous RinGo model, and aimed at people with an eye for design at an affordable price.
